- Extends `05` via cross-references instead of restating its basics; no other files touched; no global verifier run.

Fixed. I'll report to Main.

Fixed and reported to Main: all 18 inline citations now use exactly one `.md` before `:LINE` (e.g. `bots/faq.md:86`, `bots/webapps.md:1030-1051`, `bots/api.md:40-55`). Zero `.md.md:` occurrences remain; `setwebhook.md` citations and Sources URLs are unchanged. File is 6,867 bytes with structure intact.
